content: Caveats of <User_TrcvModeIndication>() : • The CanTrcv must be initialized after Power ON . • The call context is either on task level ( polling mode ). • This callback service is in general re-entrant for multiple CAN Transceiver us- age, but not for the same CAN Transceiver .
